verdict.rationale: GitBook ships a built-in GitBook Agent that users can hand work to: it flags outdated content and fixes it, drafts improvements, reviews change requests, and runs auto translations. Separately, the GitBook Assistant answers questions inside docs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how users assign arbitrary tasks to the agent and its scope or limits, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's delegation workflow (the evidence is mostly vendor headlines).
